They will work on the monthly closure of books of accounts along with preparing various SOPs to ensure the compliance goals of the organization are met. The senior finance analyst is also responsible for collaborating with cross-functional teams to support business initiatives and projects. Position Senior Financial Analyst Location IND, Bangalore, KA How You'll Create Possibilities Essential Duties & Responsibilities Oversee the preparation and distribution of financial statements, reports, financial statements, and analyses in accordance with applicable accounting standards. Support and ensure compliance to statutory and group audits. Develop and implement financial policies, procedures, and systems that support the overall goals and objectives of the organization. Collaborate with other departments to ensure that financial information is accurate, timely, and relevant to decision making. Collaborate relationships with external auditors, tax advisors, and other financial service providers. Owns deliverables and timelines, ensuring accuracy, completeness, and compliance with accounting standards and internal controls. Independently plans and prioritizes work to meet close, reporting, audit, and compliance deadlines. Manages multiple priorities effectively, particularly during peak close and audit cycles. Analyzes difficult and sometimes complex financial issues, exercising judgment to interpret accounting policies, resolve variances, and address non-routine challenges. Identifies root causes and implements practical solutions within established financial and control frameworks. Influences adherence to financial policies, procedures, and timelines through clear explanation of requirements and risks. Effectively collaborates with cross-functional partners, external auditors, and advisors to resolve issues and support business initiatives. Applies advanced knowledge of accounting standards, statutory requirements, and internal controls to ensure accurate reporting and compliance. Maintains working knowledge of applicable tax and regulatory requirements, including GST, customs duty, and other indirect taxes.
